subject.title: fix(feishu): deliver recovered final answer after tool-failure card close (#110352)

question: Which runtime-owned signal should distinguish a genuinely new reply run from the repeated `onReplyStart` keepalives that share one dispatcher lifecycle?
rationale: The current callback carries no visible run identity, so Feishu cannot safely infer whether resetting terminal state represents recovery or a keepalive without changing the lifecycle contract.

options.title: Expose a distinct reply-run boundary
options.body: Have the runtime provide a separate or identified new-run signal, then reset Feishu closed-streaming state only on that signal and retain keepalive suppression.

options.title: Keep terminal state sticky for now
options.body: Do not merge this reset until the owning runtime defines the recovered-run boundary, leaving the linked bug tracked rather than reintroducing late-final delivery.

recommendation.title: Expose a distinct reply-run boundary
recommendation.body: Have the runtime provide a separate or identified new-run signal, then reset Feishu closed-streaming state only on that signal and retain keepalive suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged lifecycle work introduced the guard and is the closest provenance for deciding the correct reply-run boundary.
